maintenance_led.reason: Sells new closures, metal food cans and plastic containers as consumable packaging to consumer goods and food companies, not repair or aftermarket.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private consumer goods and food companies buying closures, metal containers and custom plastic containers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own packaging business with periodic acquisitions; it is not a continuous roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Food cans, dispensing closures and pharma/health containers are qualified into customers' products and filling lines, so switching is costly.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call; packaging is often multi-sourced, though qualification and line integration raise switching costs.
